ios.desc:
RainBytes is a minimalist sleep aid app that immerses you in the ambiance of rain. 

It features various natural rain sounds and adorable rain animations, making it the perfect companion for power naps.

◎ Offline rain sounds.
◎ Incredibly lightweight.
◎ Built-in countdown, which can start as soon as you launch the app.
◎ With a lock screen widget for a one-tap rain experience.
◎ Enjoy it in landscape mode too!
◎ And yes, it's fully compatible with iPad.

Sound of Rain currently offers the following types of rain sounds:
◎ Gentle drizzle.
◎ Heavy rain.
◎ Thunderstorm.
◎ Rain on roof.
◎ Raincoat rustling.

In addition, accompanied by the soothing rain sounds, you can:
◎ Drown out noise distractions.
◎ Relax and calm your mind.
◎ Recall stories from rainy days gone by...

If you have any fun ideas, feel free to email the developer at kiiiidd@duck.com. 
Replies are guaranteed.

Want more rain sounds? Ideas are welcome!

quotes.text:
I built a rain sounds app (currently iOS and iPadOS only) because I struggled to fall asleep—and it actually helped me drift off faster. If you have trouble sleeping too, maybe it’ll help you as well!

- Pure rain sounds
- Runs offline, lightweight
- Smooth rain animations

Now it’s my daily companion. If you try it out, let me know what you think!
